title: A tone-assisted Chinese silent speech input method for virtual reality
authors: Zhang, Xinyu and Shan, Xinyuan and Zhou, Yang and Chen, Zihong and Tan, Peng and Xing, Youlu and Bin, Luo and Pan, Zhigeng and Feng, Guihuan
venue: International Journal of Human–Computer Interaction

summary.en: Silent lip movements and touchpad tone gestures are fused in VR to generate Mandarin Han text without acoustic speech input.
summary.zh: 在 VR 中融合无声唇动与触控板声调手势，生成普通话汉字文本，无需声学语音输入。
summary.ja: VRで無音の唇運動とタッチパッドの声調ジェスチャーを融合し、音声入力なしで標準中国語の漢字列を生成する。
summary.ko: VR에서 무음 입술 움직임과 터치패드 성조 제스처를 융합하여 음향 음성 입력 없이 표준 중국어 한자 텍스트를 생성한다.
